name: deepseek-peak-hour-monitoring
description: Shows in the status bar whether you are inside or outside DeepSeek peak hours (pricing/usage), when the current peak ends, and notifies you about active DeepSeek status incidents (status.deepseek.com). Configurable.

commands.title: DeepSeek Peak Hours: Show status now

deepseekPeak.windowsUtc.description: Peak hour windows in UTC, format "HH:MM-HH:MM" (start before end, within the same day). Default = DeepSeek.

deepseekPeak.weekdays.description: Weekdays on which the peak applies (0 = Sunday, ..., 6 = Saturday). Default Monday to Friday.

deepseekPeak.notifyOnChange.description: Show a notification when the status changes (entering or leaving peak).

deepseekPeak.notifyMinutesBefore.description: Minutes before a status change at which to notify (e.g. "peak ends in ~10 minutes"). 0 = disabled.

deepseekPeak.monitorStatus.description: Monitor the DeepSeek status feed (status.deepseek.com) and surface active incidents.

deepseekPeak.statusFeedUrl.description: RSS/Atom feed URL used for DeepSeek status monitoring. Supports both feed.rss and feed.atom.

deepseekPeak.statusCheckIntervalMinutes.description: How often (in minutes) to check the DeepSeek status feed for incidents.

deepseekPeak.notifyOnStatusIncident.description: Show a notification when a DeepSeek status incident starts or is resolved.
